reader.requirement: Every RD's report-name-1 must be named by exactly one REPORT clause of the program's FDs: an RD named by none, named by two FDs' REPORT clauses, or named twice inside one REPORT clause must be refused; one FD naming several reports, or several FDs each naming a different report, is legal.

reader.notes: ScreenReportClauseNames walks every FD's REPORT names once and refuses a second occurrence (same or another FD); ResolveReports refuses an RD that no FD names. The path is edition-free and the 1985 rule is the same requirement as the later editions'.
